papers.title: Parallel Predictive Entropy Search for Batch Global Optimization of Expensive Objective Functions
papers.abstract: We develop parallel predictive entropy search (PPES), a novel algorithm for Bayesian optimization of expensive black-box objective functions. At each iteration, PPES aims to select a batch of points which will maximize the information gain about the global maximizer of the objective. Well known strategies exist for suggesting a single evaluation point based on previous observations, while far fewer are known for selecting batches of points to evaluate in parallel. The few batch selection schemes that have been studied all resort to greedy methods to compute an optimal batch. To the best of our knowledge, PPES is the first non-greedy batch Bayesian optimization strategy. We demonstrate the benefit of this approach in optimization performance on both synthetic and real world applications, including problems in machine learning, rocket science and robotics.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的并行贝叶斯优化方法可直接用于提高昂贵仿真（如生物力学有限元分析）的采样效率，但未涉及约束处理和植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification beyond standard Gaussian process, or validation on biomechanical/implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决并行贝叶斯优化中批量选点问题，提高采样效率
summary_zh.method: 提出非贪婪的并行预测熵搜索方法，最大化信息增益
summary_zh.result: 在合成和实际问题中优于现有贪婪批量方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和机器学习等实际基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: The authors aim to develop a batch Bayesian optimization algorithm that efficiently selects multiple evaluation points in parallel to maximize information gain about the global optimum.
summary_en.method: They propose Parallel Predictive Entropy Search (PPES), a non-greedy batch selection strategy that sequentially constructs a batch by maximizing mutual information.
summary_en.result: PPES demonstrates improved optimization performance compared to greedy batch methods on synthetic and real-world problems from machine learning, rocket science, and robotics.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic functions and real-world applications including machine learning hyperparameter tuning, rocket trajectory design, and robot gait optimization.

papers.title: Evolution of the electronic and lattice structure with carrier injection in BiFeO$_3$
papers.abstract: We report a density functional study on the evolution of the electronic and lattice structure in BiFeO$_3$ with injected electrons and holes. First, the self-trapping of electrons and holes were investigated. We found that the injected electrons tend to be localized on Fe sites due to the local lattice expansion, the on-site Coulomb interaction of Fe $3d$ electrons, and the antiferromagnetic order in BiFeO$_3$. The injected holes tend to be delocalized if the on-site Coulomb interaction of O $2p$ is weak (in other words, $U_\mathrm{O}$ is small). Single center polarons and multi-center polarons are formed with large and intermediate $U_\mathrm{O}$, respectively. With intermediate $U_\mathrm{O}$, multi-center polarons can be formed. We also studied the lattice distortion with the injection of carriers by assuming the delocalization of these carriers. We found that the ferroelectric off-centering of BiFeO$_3$ increases with the concentration of the electrons injected and decreases with that of the holes injected. It was also found that a structural phase transition from $R3c$ to the non-ferroelectric $Pbnm$ occurs, with the hole concentration over 8.7$\times10^{19} cm^{-3}$. The change of the off-centering is mainly due to the change of the lattice volume. The understanding of the carrier localization mechanism can help to optimize the functionality of ferroelectric diodes and the ferroelectric photovoltage devices, while the understanding of the evolution of the lattice with carriers can help tuning the ferroelectric properties by the carriers in BiFeO$_3$.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铁电材料BiFeO3的电子和晶格结构，与用户的研究方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a pure density functional theory study on ferroelectric material BiFeO3, with no biomedical context, no additive manufacturing, no mechanical testing, and no implant-related content.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究BiFeO3中载流子注入对电子和晶格结构的影响
summary_zh.method: 使用密度泛函理论计算电子和空穴的自陷及晶格畸变
summary_zh.result: 发现电子趋向局域化，空穴趋向离域化，载流子浓度影响铁电偏移

summary_en.motivation: To understand the evolution of electronic and lattice structure in BiFeO3 under carrier injection.
summary_en.method: Density functional theory calculations were performed to investigate self-trapping of electrons and holes and lattice distortion.
summary_en.result: Electrons localize at Fe sites while holes delocalize; ferroelectric off-centering increases with electron injection and decreases with hole injection.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical DFT calculations without experimental validation.

papers.title: Analyzing Biological Performance of 3D-Printed, Cell-Impregnated Hybrid Constructs for Cartilage Tissue Engineering
papers.abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) bioprinting of hybrid constructs is a promising biofabrication method for cartilage tissue engineering because a synthetic polymer framework and cell-impregnated hydrogel provide structural and biological features of cartilage, respectively. During bioprinting, impregnated cells may be subjected to high temperatures (caused by the adjacent melted polymer) and process-induced mechanical forces, potentially compromising cell function. This study addresses these biofabrication issues, evaluating the heat distribution of printed polycaprolactone (PCL) strands and the rheological property and structural stability of alginate hydrogels at various temperatures and concentrations. The biocompatibility of parameters from these studies was tested by culturing 3D hybrid constructs bioprinted with primary cells from embryonic chick cartilage. During initial two-dimensional culture expansion of these primary cells, two morphologically and molecularly distinct cell populations ("rounded" and "fibroblastic") were isolated. The biological performance of each population was evaluated in 3D hybrid constructs separately. The cell viability, proliferation, and cartilage differentiation were observed at high levels in hybrid constructs of both cell populations, confirming the validity of these 3D bioprinting parameters for effective cartilage tissue engineering. Statistically significant performance variations were observed, however, between the rounded and fibroblastic cell populations. Molecular and morphological data support the notion that such performance differences may be attributed to the relative differentiation state of rounded versus fibroblastic cells (i.e., differentiated chondrocytes vs. chondroprogenitors, respectively), which is a relevant issue for cell-based tissue engineering strategies. Taken together, our study demonstrates that bioprinting 3D hybrid constructs of PCL and cell-impregnated alginate hydrogel is a promising approach for cartilage tissue engineering.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估3D生物打印混合支架中细胞活性和分化。
summary_zh.method: 打印PCL和海藻酸水凝胶复合支架，分离两种细胞群进行培养。
summary_zh.result: 两种细胞群均表现良好，但圆形细胞（分化软骨细胞）性能更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞培养验证打印参数和生物相容性。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the biological performance of 3D-printed hybrid constructs for cartilage tissue engineering, focusing on cell viability and differentiation.
summary_en.method: Hybrid constructs of PCL and cell-impregnated alginate hydrogel were bioprinted, and two distinct cell populations (rounded and fibroblastic) were isolated and cultured separately.
summary_en.result: Both cell populations showed high viability and cartilage differentiation, with rounded cells demonstrating superior performance attributed to their differentiated state.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments with primary chick cartilage cells validated the biocompatibility of the printing parameters.
